cues.en: Patrick, thanks so much for looking after Courtney.
How on earth did you get a reservation there?
cues.zh: 你到底是怎么在那儿订到位的？

cues.en: That's a wonderful suit. Don't tell me. Don't tell me. Let me guess.
cues.zh: 这套西装真漂亮。别告诉我。别告诉我。让我猜猜。

cues.en: How the hell are you? Alan has mistaken me for this dickhead, Marcus Halberstram.
cues.zh: 你最近怎么样？Alan把我误认成了那个混蛋，Marcus Halberstram。

cues.en: It seems logical because Marcus also works at PNP and in fact does the same exact thing I do. He also has a pension for Valentino suits and Oliver Peoples glasses.
cues.zh: 这似乎也说得通，因为Marcus也在PNP工作，而且实际上做的工作和我一模一样。他还偏爱Valentino西装和Oliver Peoples眼镜。

cues.en: Marcus and I even go to the same barber. Although, I have a slightly better haircut. So how's the ransom account going, Marcus? It's, it's alright. Really? That's interesting. It's not, it's not great. Oh, well, you know. So how's Cecilia?
cues.zh: Marcus 和我甚至找的是同一个理发师。不过，我的发型稍微帅一点。对了，Marcus，那个赎金账户进展如何？还、还可以吧。真的吗？挺有意思。其实不太好，不算太顺利。哎，好吧，你懂的。那 Cecilia 怎么样了？

cues.en: She's a great girl. Oh, yeah. I'm very lucky. Mhmm. Hey, Alan. Congratulations on the Fisher account. Thank you, Baxter. Listen, Paul, squash.
cues.zh: 她是个好姑娘。是啊。我很幸运。嗯哼。嘿，Alan。恭喜拿下 Fisher 的单子。谢谢你，Baxter。对了，Paul，打壁球的事。

cues.en: I got an 08:30 res at Dorcia.
Dorcia on Friday night. How do swing that? I think he's lying.
cues.zh: 周五晚上的Dorcia。你怎么做到的？我觉得他在撒谎。

cues.en: Look at that. Picked them up from the printers yesterday.
cues.zh: 看看这个。昨天刚从印刷厂拿回来的。

cues.en: And the lettering is something called Scylian Braille. It's very cool, Bateman, but that's nothing.
cues.zh: 字体是一种叫Scylian Braille的。很酷，Bateman，但那不算什么。

cues.en: That is really nice. Eggshell with Rimalian type.
cues.zh: 那真漂亮。蛋壳色配Rimalian字体。

cues.en: That is really super. How did nitwit like you get so tasteful?
cues.zh: 真挺棒的。你这种笨蛋怎么会这么有品位？

cues.en: I can't believe that Bryce prefers Van Patton's card to mine. But wait,
cues.zh: 我不敢相信 Bryce 居然觉得 Van Patton 的名片比我的好。不过等等，
再看看 Paul Allen 的名片。

cues.en: Look at that subtle off white coloring,
a tasteful thickness of it. Oh my god.
cues.zh: 恰到好处的厚度。我的天。
